Subject: Discovery follow-up: demo / technical deep dive + rotating time slots

Hi Liam (and Natalie),

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the context on Acme's embedding-heavy search use case and the performance/cost targets you shared. Quick recap and next steps below so we can lock a technical deep dive with our SE (Aditya).

Recap (high level)
- Goal: reduce per-query cost by ~30% while keeping 95th-pct latency < 250ms for 512-token responses
- Primary workloads: semantic search + reranking; peak traffic in EU daytime, steady US morning traffic, occasional APAC batch jobs
- Constraints: SOC2 + data residency for EU customers

Proposed next step: 30-minute technical deep dive (Aditya + Marissa) to walk architecture/serving options and sketch an initial rollout plan. Because your team spans multiple regions, we suggest a rotating meeting cadence so times are fair to EU/US/APAC participants. Example rotation (weekly):

- Week A — US-friendly: Tue/Thu 8:30–9:30 AM PDT (4:30–5:30 PM CEST / 1:30–2:30 AM SGT next day)
- Week B — EU-friendly: Wed/Fri 3:00–4:00 PM CEST (6:00–7:00 AM PDT / 10:00–11:00 PM SGT)
- Week C — APAC-friendly: Tue 9:00–10:00 PM SGT (2:00–3:00 AM CEST / 5:00–6:00 AM PDT)

We know APAC windows are rough; the idea is to rotate so no single region always gets the late slot. For the immediate deep dive, here are specific slots we can offer next week — all 30-minute slots:
- Option 1: Tue Jul 28, 2026 8:30 AM PDT / 5:30 PM CEST
- Option 2: Wed Jul 29, 2026 3:00 PM CEST / 6:00 AM PDT
- Option 3: Thu Jul 30, 2026 9:00 PM SGT / 2:00 AM PDT (APAC-friendly)

Please reply with which option works best for you and whether you'd like Aditya to focus on perf/cost tuning, security/compliance, or both. I've attached a short agenda (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf) and you can also pick a time via our Calendly if that's easier: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30

Sign-off:
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
